import type { TextareaContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface TextareaProps extends TextareaContract {
    placeholder?: string;
    help?: string;
    error?: string;
}
export declare function Textarea({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, label, id: provided, name, required, disabled, readOnly, rows, maxLength, invalid, helpId, errorId, placeholder, help, error }: TextareaProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
